description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of task types related to a study on generative AI’s use in journalism. The chart contains three slices, representing “Task,” “Article generation,” and “Article editing.” The “Task” slice is red and occupies approximately 82.9% of the chart, while the “Article generation” slice is light blue and represents approximately 14.6% of the chart. A smaller, yellow slice represents the remaining task type, though its precise proportion is not labeled. Percentage labels are displayed directly within the “Task” and “Article generation” slices. The slices are arranged clockwise, with the largest slice, “Task,” positioned at the top and the slices decreasing in size as they proceed clockwise. A legend is not present, but the task types are labeled directly adjacent to their corresponding slices.
